info.title: GaryAI chat API
info.description: Programmatic access to GaryAI, Gary King's AI avatar (gking.harvard.edu/ask-gary). Answers questions about Gary King's research, quantitative social-science methods, software, teaching, and academic-career advice, citing sources on gking.harvard.edu. No authentication. An automated topic screener refuses unrelated questions. The server is stateless: resend full conversation history each turn. Human-readable docs: https://gking.harvard.edu/llms.txt. An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing the same capability as the ask_gary tool lives at https://d325iygsd5krw9.cloudfront.net/api/mcp

value.question: How should I analyze a large biographical dataset?

200.description: With stream:false (or the question shorthand): a single JSON object, possibly preceded by keep-alive whitespace, which JSON parsers ignore. Without stream:false: Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream) of {type: token|attached_figures|previews|done|error} objects — the mode the website UI uses.

schema.description: SSE stream: data: {"type":"token","content":"..."} events, then optional attached_figures / previews events, ending with {"type":"done","last_cited_asset_id":...}

400.description: Malformed request (JSON mode only; SSE mode reports errors as an in-stream event).

ChatRequest.description: Provide either `question` (one-shot shorthand; implies stream:false) or `messages` (full history, required for follow-ups).

question.description: One-shot question. Shorthand for a single-turn messages array; implies stream:false unless stream is explicitly true.

messages.description: Full conversation history, oldest first. Required when question is absent.

stream.description: false → single JSON response. Omitted/true → SSE stream.

conversation_id.description: Stable id for grouping turns in server logs. Generated and returned if omitted in JSON mode.

source.description: Identify your agent/app (please set — helps the maintainers attribute traffic).

last_cited_asset_id.description: Echo the value from the previous turn's response so references like "that paper" resolve.
Send back on the next turn.

error.description: Present instead of reply when generation failed.
